runs.content: Auto Trader Group (LSE, 452.80p) was bought as the day's value pick. It trades ~14x earnings with ~49% ROIC and sits 6% above its 52-week low after a ~45% de-rating on AI-disruption and Deal Builder fears. Management is buying back shares heavily, and the 562p consensus target sits at T1. DHI was exited as a capacity trim (−6.41%, −$64); it was chosen over the weaker HUM as the stalest thesis. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $2.18 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,166 (+1.67% on $70,000).

Incyte (NASDAQ, $123.20) was bought as the day's momentum pick. It sits ~5% below its 52-week high above a rising 200-day average, raised FY26 net-sales guidance to $5.13–5.26B in July, and trades at ~11x EV/EBIT with $4.5B cash, a Burry-aligned healthcare name. OXY was exited as a capacity trim (−7.04%, −$70) to hold the book at 35 positions, which also trims energy concentration. No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.44 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$1,423 (+2.06% on $69,000).
